title: Reyana
storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

entities.name: Reyana
entities.description: Auriok woman on New Phyrexia, rearguard and firebird keeper in Neyali's resistance cell, who let herself become compleated.

entities.name: Neyali
entities.description: Reyana's childhood friend and leader of a resistance cell.

entities.name: Reyana's mother
entities.description: Compleated mother who abused Reyana, now a Phyrexian aspirant at peace.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: Monstrous goblin Phyrexian who promises false peace through compleation.

entities.name: Quiet Furnace
entities.description: Site of Reyana's encounter with her mother.

entities.name: Salvage Complex
entities.description: Place where Reyana's betrayal was revealed.

events.summary: After a Phyrexian massacre decimates her village, Reyana wanders the ruins of Mirrex alone until Neyali and Otharri find her and integrate her into their cell.
events.quote: Neyali and her firebird Otharri eventually found and integrated Reyana into their resistance cell.

events.summary: In the Quiet Furnace Reyana faces her mother, now a Phyrexian aspirant, abandons her weapons and despairs; Neyali's intervention saves her.
events.quote: Neyali's intervention saved her physically, but the emotional scars remained.

events.summary: Torn by longing for peace, Reyana leaves a note and disappears; the others search for her.
events.quote: This inner turmoil drove her to leave a note and disappear

events.summary: At the Salvage Complex Reyana's betrayal is revealed: she willingly seeks compleation promised by Slobad.

relations.quote: As a member of Neyali 's resistance cell, Reyana assumes the role of rear guard
who as a child was beaten by her mother.
